sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Plum candle shaped like a soft blob, lilac flame, charcoal saucer, gold eye dots.

name: Frostpost Gift Pile
description: The wrapping is almost too nice to disturb. Almost.
sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Three stacked gifts, cream paper, navy pine print, coral ribbons, gold round tags.

name: Wishcoil Lantern
description: A coiled paper glow for the year's brightest shared evening.
sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Coral spiral paper lantern, gold wire ribs, cream center glow, plum tassel foot.

name: Budcurl Flower Cart
description: A small cart carrying an unreasonable amount of spring.
sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Cream flower cart, lilac wheels, rose blossoms, mint foliage, sand wooden handle.

name: Hushpuff Door Arch
description: A doorway dressed up for delightfully mild surprises.
sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Charcoal padded doorway arch, plum scallops, lilac dangling puff shapes, gold ribbon ties.

name: Frostglimmer Hearth
description: The room's warmest invitation to stay a little longer.
sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Cream tile hearth, navy mantel, coral fire glow, gold star tiles, dark inset firebox.

name: Wishdance Screen
description: A folding screen full of movement, music, and fresh starts.
sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Three coral lacquer screen panels, gold ribbon dancer silhouettes, plum hinges, cream cloud borders.

name: Budrain Arbor
description: Petals gather overhead like the gentlest possible weather.
sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Cream curved arbor, dense rose blossoms, mint leaf trails, lilac hanging petal strands.

name: Frostwish Carousel
description: Little sleighs circle slowly through a pocket of holiday light.
sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Navy miniature carousel, cream canopy, coral sleigh seats, gold lit stars, round wooden platform.

name: Lanternplait Moon Gate
description: A luminous circle for stepping into a hopeful new year.
sprite_brief: Top-down 3/4: Coral circular moon gate, gold braided frame, cream paper lights, plum tassels, broad square feet.
